signals.claim: China's September 15 antimony export-control start date was arriving against an already tight global market, while domestic antimony prices were still holding at historically high levels in the final pre-control week.

evidence.summary: Reuters reported export restrictions effective September 15, China at roughly 48% of global mined antimony in 2023, a pre-existing global supply deficit and overseas prices above USD22,000/t.
SMM reported domestic antimony prices remained firm: 1# antimony ingot about RMB161,000/t and antimony trioxide roughly RMB136,000-143,000/t.

contraryEvidence.summary: The controls require export licences for covered antimony products. A Chinese producer is therefore not automatically a beneficiary of overseas scarcity; domestic realization and licensing matter.

causalChain: global antimony deficit + constrained mine/refining supply -> high antimony prices
China export licensing can tighten ex-China availability further
upstream owners with already-producing antimony resources can benefit only if higher realizable domestic/product prices reach their own sales mix
profit impact depends on self-produced metal volume, product mix, export exposure and mine execution rather than headline antimony price alone
signals.beneficiaryArchetype: An already-producing antimony miner/refiner with owned resource, material antimony gross-profit contribution, proven production rather than undeveloped reserves, a company-realized product mix that can capture high domestic antimony prices, and valuation that does not require an extreme permanent price.

opportunityAssessment.profitPoolChange: Potentially shifts toward scarce operating antimony resources, but export controls can also limit overseas monetization by Chinese producers.
opportunityAssessment.duration: Multi-quarter if global mine supply remains constrained; less durable if high prices trigger substitution, recycled supply or new mine output.
opportunityAssessment.expectationGap: The policy was known for a month and antimony-related equities had already attracted attention, so company-specific price/earnings reconciliation is essential.
opportunityAssessment.keyUncertainty: Whether high market antimony prices translate into each company's realized antimony gross profit and volume.

candidates.name: 湖南黄金
candidates.economicExposure: 2024 H1 antimony-product revenue was about RMB1.128bn. Although only 7.45% of reported revenue because external gold trading inflates the denominator, antimony gross profit was roughly RMB454m, making the segment economically material.
candidates.monetization: The company had 25,000 t/year refined-antimony and 40,000 t/year multi-antimony-product production lines and reported 15,147 t H1 antimony-product output. Existing production can monetize high domestic antimony product prices, but self-produced antimony was lower YoY and export controls are not automatically positive for realized price.
earningsBridge: tight antimony supply and high domestic product prices
realized price/mix on refined antimony, contained antimony and antimony oxide
candidates.balanceSheetCycle: H1 operating cash flow was much weaker YoY despite higher profit, so earnings quality and working-capital movement should be considered in valuation scenarios.
candidates.competitiveQuality: Large established antimony production lines, mining/refining integration and long-running antimony trading/export capability are stronger than a concept-only exposure.
candidates.priceExpectation: Pre-signal price and valuation context will be added deterministically before final Candidate/Watch classification.
contraryEvidence: Antimony was 7.45% of reported revenue, so the thesis must be judged on gross profit rather than headline revenue share.
H1 self-produced antimony volume declined YoY.
Export licensing can constrain direct overseas monetization even if foreign prices rise.
thesisBreakers: domestic antimony realized prices fall despite overseas scarcity
self-produced antimony volume continues to decline
export-control implementation reduces profitable sales channels more than price gains help
gold/other business weakness overwhelms antimony profit improvement
unansweredQuestions: How much H2 antimony volume is self-produced versus externally sourced material?
What level of antimony price is already embedded in the pre-signal share price?

pointInTimeEvidence.summary: 2024 H1 report: total antimony-product revenue RMB1.128bn, cost RMB673.7m; H1 attributable net profit RMB438.1m; 25kt/year refined-antimony and 40kt/year multi-antimony-product production lines.

candidates.name: 华钰矿业
candidates.economicExposure: The company owns domestic gold/antimony resources and a 50%-held Tajikistan gold-antimony project. H1 revenue was RMB592.8m and attributable net profit RMB109.2m.
candidates.monetization: Resource concentration is attractive, but point-in-time execution evidence was mixed. An August 31 field report cited a customer saying TALCO Gold ore grade appeared below expectations, while company staff conditioned a roughly 4,000 metal-ton annual antimony estimate on throughput, grade and technology.
earningsBridge: TALCO/domestic antimony metal actually produced and sold
equity-accounted / consolidated earnings and cash flow
candidates.balanceSheetCycle: Small earnings base creates large upside sensitivity but also high execution sensitivity; overseas project operations and mine-grade uncertainty dominate the thesis.
candidates.competitiveQuality: Large antimony resource endowment is potentially scarce, but undeveloped/underperforming ore cannot be valued like proven output.
candidates.priceExpectation: Pre-signal price and valuation context will be added deterministically, but execution evidence must remain a gating issue even if valuation appears cheap.
contraryEvidence: A pre-cutoff customer report questioned TALCO Gold antimony ore grade.
Company staff said ~4,000 metal tons depended on throughput, grade and technology conditions.
H1 profit growth alone does not prove full design production.
thesisBreakers: TALCO ore grade or recovery remains below design assumptions
annual antimony output materially misses the production plan
domestic/overseas antimony prices weaken before output ramps
unansweredQuestions: What was the proven H1 antimony metal output and sale volume from TALCO?
How much of future profit depends on the disputed grade assumption?

pointInTimeEvidence.summary: 2024 H1 report: revenue RMB592.8m, attributable net profit RMB109.2m, attributable equity RMB3.252bn.
Cailian Press reported a customer concern that TALCO Gold antimony grade was below expectation; company staff said roughly 4,000 metal tons/year was conditional on throughput, grade and technology.

finalDecision.noTradeReason: Prefreeze stage: both direct antimony names remain Watch until pre-signal valuation/expectation context is reconciled. 华钰 also has unresolved operating-grade risk.

signals.claim: China alumina spot prices had risen to a two-year high by mid-September 2024 as primary-aluminium demand remained strong and bauxite availability constrained alumina supply.

evidence.summary: SMM data reported China average alumina spot price around RMB3,968/t on September 13, up RMB1,035/t YoY, with strong primary-aluminium demand and tight bauxite availability cited as drivers.

contraryEvidence.summary: China Aluminum is vertically integrated across alumina and primary aluminum. Higher alumina prices benefit the upstream segment but can also raise downstream input economics, so group exposure is not a pure alumina-price long.

causalChain: tight bauxite + high alumina demand -> alumina spot price rises
alumina producers with secure ore and operating capacity can capture higher upstream margin
integrated aluminum producers may partly offset that benefit through higher downstream feedstock costs
net company earnings require segment-level rather than commodity-price-only analysis
signals.beneficiaryArchetype: A low-cost alumina producer with secure bauxite, operating capacity, high alumina earnings materiality and limited downstream aluminum offset, trading at a valuation that does not already price a sustained high alumina spread.

opportunityAssessment.profitPoolChange: Positive for low-cost alumina capacity, potentially offset for vertically integrated primary-aluminum producers.
opportunityAssessment.duration: Cyclical/multi-quarter and dependent on bauxite normalization and new alumina capacity.
opportunityAssessment.expectationGap: Alumina strength was visible by mid-September; company-specific net exposure and valuation are the key unknowns.
opportunityAssessment.keyUncertainty: Whether upstream alumina margin gains are retained at group level after bauxite costs and downstream aluminum economics.

candidates.name: 中国铝业
candidates.economicExposure: 2024 H1 attributable net profit was RMB7.016bn and the company had large alumina and primary-aluminum operations; alumina segment profit was already substantial before the September price signal.
candidates.monetization: Large owned alumina production can capture a higher alumina spread, but integrated primary-aluminum operations consume alumina and create an internal offset.
earningsBridge: downstream primary-aluminum offset and group cost structure
candidates.balanceSheetCycle: Large integrated asset base lowers pure commodity sensitivity; bauxite sourcing, energy cost, capex and minority interests matter.
candidates.competitiveQuality: Scale, integration and resource security can be advantages, but integration also makes this a less pure beneficiary of alumina price inflation.
candidates.priceExpectation: Pre-signal price and valuation context will be added deterministically; absent a clean net group earnings sensitivity the maximum prefreeze decision is Watch.
contraryEvidence: Higher alumina prices can be an input-cost headwind for the group's primary-aluminum segment.
The company had already delivered very strong H1 earnings growth, so part of the favorable cycle was already visible.
thesisBreakers: bauxite availability normalizes and alumina prices fall
downstream aluminum margin compression offsets upstream gains
new alumina capacity erodes the spread
higher ore/energy costs absorb the apparent alumina-price benefit
unansweredQuestions: What is group net profit sensitivity to a sustained RMB100/t alumina spread change after internal consumption?
How much H2 alumina strength was already reflected in the pre-signal market valuation?

pointInTimeEvidence.summary: 2024 H1: attributable net profit RMB7.016bn, attributable equity RMB66.413bn, operating cash flow RMB13.549bn.

finalDecision.noTradeReason: Prefreeze stage: strong commodity signal but the listed-company mapping is mixed because 中国铝业 is vertically integrated rather than a pure alumina exposure.

signals.claim: Ocean container spot rates remained elevated but were rolling over by early September as the unusually early peak season faded, especially on Asia-Europe lanes.

evidence.summary: Freightos reported Asia-North Europe rates down 13% for the week and more than 20% below July highs, describing an early peak season that had likely closed early as seasonal demand dried up.

contraryEvidence.summary: Rates remained historically elevated and Red Sea diversions were still absorbing capacity; transpacific volumes also remained strong into August.

causalChain: spot freight rates begin declining from July highs
shipping earnings upside from the June squeeze becomes less asymmetric
without a fresh company-specific expectation gap, a new long becomes less attractive
signals.beneficiaryArchetype: No clean long archetype is forced from a falling freight-rate signal. A new long would require a different source of earnings growth not dependent on the fading spot-rate shock.

opportunityAssessment.profitPoolChange: Potentially negative at the margin for carriers exposed to spot-rate normalization.
opportunityAssessment.expectationGap: The direction of the June shock was reversing, so the prior shipping long thesis should not be mechanically recycled.
opportunityAssessment.keyUncertainty: US port-strike risk and continued Red Sea diversions could temporarily re-tighten capacity.

finalDecision.noTradeReason: NO TRADE. This is primarily a warning that the earlier freight squeeze was losing momentum, not a clean long opportunity.
